zh.pageTitle: HKSOP Harness · 从光路图到制造交付
zh.eyebrow: 可执行光路图 → 实体加工总装
zh.heroTitle: 写一张光路图，交付整套可加工光机总装。
zh.heroDescription: 从偏振感知的 Python 光路追迹出发，自动完成二维面包板排板、定制转接件建模，直至 OpenCascade 三维净空复核与车间加工、采购交付包导出。
zh.explore: 查看 532 nm 一分三示例
zh.installCTA: 安装到 AI 客户端
zh.statClearance: 21 段光束 · 三维净空下界
zh.statGrid: 标准 M6 孔阵 · 62.5 mm 光高
zh.sliderLabel: 原理图与三维总装分割位置
zh.assemblyAlt: PM-532 一分三 R2 数字总装与绿色光路
zh.schematicAlt: PM-532 一分三 R2 逻辑光路原理图
zh.exampleDescription: 东侧保偏输入，南侧三路以 112.5 mm 等距输出。四组双波片与级间 HWP 独立补偿偏振；3 mW 无损模型分为 3 × 1 mW，系统目标 PER ≥ 20 dB。
zh.evidenceNote: 净空来自数字总装核验；实际功率、插损与 PER 待实测。两视图展示不同层次，不作同尺度几何叠合。
zh.pipelineTitle: 四个插件，一条可追溯的交付链。
zh.pipelineDescription: 各阶段只加载自己的规则与工具，以冻结的文件传递证据。定制件按需介入，入库后返回排板复验。
zh.branchNote: 主线：光路原理 → 二维排板 → 三维与制造。缺件时进入定制支线，完成入库后回到二维排板，不绕过复验。
zh.installTitle: 一键部署到你的 AI 编程客户端。
zh.installDescription: 第一层仅用 Python 标准库。排板与三维环节再接入匹配的 HKSOP 本体、元件库和 CAD 环境。
zh.quickDescription: Python 3.11+，无需安装第三方 Python 包。在仓库根目录运行，得到原理图、追迹与离线展示页。
zh.client_antigravity: 复制到本地插件目录，再在客户端插件界面启用需要的阶段。安装器不修改账号或全局启用列表。
zh.client_codex: 首次使用时添加本仓库的 hksop-local 本地市场，再选装插件。更新已启用的缓存可追加 --update --sync-codex-cache。
zh.client_dsh: 安装时自动组装 Cordis 包，再在桌面插件管理中选择对应本地包；四个插件可分别启停。
zh.updateNote: 去掉 --apply 可先预演；升级追加 --update。来源不明或带有本地修改的副本会被保护。
zh.compatDescription: 版本与依赖以兼容清单为准。
zh.compatNote: 工具链、四插件与兼容清单统一为 1.3.0。上游源码提交与已核验整理版目录分别锁定；仅克隆本体不等于已具备全部元件与原厂模型。

zh.fontNotice: HKSOP 字标与 Manrope 字体：SIL OFL 1.1。原厂模型按各自授权另行获取。
zh.compatLink: 查看兼容清单与资产要求 ↗
zh.tagline: From AI, for AI. 构建 AI 原生实验系统！
zh.stage0_description: 端口追迹功率、琼斯偏振、频移与高斯光束，拦截悬空光路与保偏错误。
zh.stage0_detail: 用 graph.py 构建可重放输入；处理 ERROR，明确仍需实测的 WARNING。
zh.stage1_description: 90° 正交通道自动布局，安排滑台与 25 × 30 mm 操作净空，生成原生工程与缺件清单。
zh.stage1_detail: 将 trace.json 交给 optical_graph_to_board.py，生成 .zzoptics.json 并运行原生 verify。
zh.stage2_description: 承接落孔与非标转接需求，生成 STEP、第一角法加工图与受控元件入库。
zh.stage2_detail: parse_wishes.py 生成 cad-tasks.json；核实接口与实模，再由 library-intake 登记后返回排板。
zh.stage3_description: OpenCascade 回读真实模型与光束包络，锁定铭牌、加工包与归并采购 BOM。
zh.stage3_gate: STEP 回读 · SHA256 锁定
zh.stage3_detail: 冻结工程、空间回执和源资产；用 export_packages.py 依据受控清单生成两个交付 ZIP。

en.pageTitle: HKSOP Harness · Optical Graph to Manufacturing
en.heroTitle: Write One Optical Graph. Ship a Machined 3D Assembly.
en.heroDescription: From a polarization-aware optical graph in Python to automated 2D breadboard routing, custom CAD adapters, OpenCascade 3D beam-clearance verification, and shop-ready manufacturing & BOM packs.
en.assemblyAlt: PM-532 1×3 R2 digital assembly with green beam paths
en.exampleDescription: East PM fiber launch to three 112.5 mm-spaced south outputs. Four dual-waveplate ports plus an inter-stage HWP split 3 mW into 3 × 1 mW in the lossless model; target PER ≥ 20 dB.
en.evidenceNote: Clearance is verified in CAD; physical power, insertion loss and PER remain to be measured. The two views show different representations, not a common geometric scale.
en.pipelineDescription: Each stage loads its own rules and tools, passing evidence through frozen files. Custom CAD is an optional branch that returns to board verification.
en.branchNote: Main line: Optical Graph → Board Layout → 3D & Manufacture. Missing parts enter the custom branch and return to board verification after intake.
en.installTitle: Install into Your AI Coding Client.
en.installDescription: Layer 1 uses only the Python standard library. Layout and 3D stages additionally require compatible HKSOP Core, its component catalog and a CAD environment.
en.quickDescription: Python 3.11+ with no third-party Python packages. Run from the repository root to produce a schematic, trace and offline gallery.
en.client_antigravity: Copies the four plugins locally. Enable the stages you need in the client’s plugin interface. Account settings and enablement remain managed by the host.
en.client_codex: Add this repository’s hksop-local marketplace on first use, then install the plugins. To refresh an existing active cache, add --update --sync-codex-cache.
en.client_dsh: The installer assembles Cordis packages on demand. Select the local packages in the desktop plugin manager; all four can be enabled independently.
en.updateNote: Omit --apply to preview. Add --update for upgrades. Unrecognized or locally modified copies are protected.
en.compatDescription: Versions and dependencies are pinned in the compatibility manifest.
en.compatNote: Toolchain, four plugins and compatibility manifest are aligned at 1.3.0. The upstream commit and validated curated catalog are pinned separately; a core clone alone does not provide every component or supplier model.
en.copyright: All Rights Reserved · No open-source license granted
en.fontNotice: HKSOP wordmark and Manrope typeface: SIL OFL 1.1. Supplier models are acquired separately under their own terms.
en.tagline: From AI, for AI. Building an AI-native experimental system!
en.stage0_description: Propagates power, Jones polarization, frequency shift and Gaussian beams across directional ports.
en.stage0_detail: Build replayable input in graph.py. Resolve ERROR diagnostics and disclose WARNING conditions that need physical validation.
en.stage1_description: Routes orthogonal channels on M6 grids with translation stages, hand-clearance checks and custom-part wishes.
en.stage1_detail: Pass trace.json to optical_graph_to_board.py, generate .zzoptics.json and run native verify.
en.stage2_description: Converts optical datums and wishes into verified adapter CAD, GB first-angle shop drawings and curated intake.
en.stage2_detail: parse_wishes.py creates cad-tasks.json. Verify interfaces and real geometry, register through library-intake, then return to layout.
en.stage3_description: Reconstructs STEP assemblies in OpenCascade, audits 3D beam clearance and locks machining and procurement ZIPs.
en.stage3_detail: Freeze the project, clearance receipt and source assets. export_packages.py produces two release ZIPs from the controlled manifest.
